changeSet.author: hugmesh
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO games (id, name, description, slug, sort_order, created_at) SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id), 0) + 1 FROM games), 'Shadows of the Net – CHAT', 'A noir cyber chat chamber in XR: sit around the round table with up to 16 participants rendered as procedural 3D characters, share media onto the table plates, wall screens and the spotlit stage, and enter the room in VR from a Quest browser or flat on any desktop. Pure-GDScript Godot bundle, host-authoritative seat/stage state.', 'shadows-of-the-net', (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sort_order), 0) + 1 FROM games), NOW() WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM games WHERE slug = 'shadows-of-the-net');

changeSet.author: hugmesh
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO chapters (name, description, slug, scene_type, sort_order, asset_url, scene_config, game_id, created_at) SELECT 'The Chamber', 'The circular noir room: center round table with six media plates, four wall screens, a spotlit stage and a 16-seat ring. The session creator arbitrates seats and the stage; everyone relays their pose on the movement channel.', 'shadows-of-the-net', 'shadows-of-the-net', 1, '/_remotes/wasm-fragment/shadows-of-the-net/index.html', '{}', (SELECT id FROM games WHERE slug = 'shadows-of-the-net'), NOW() WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chapters WHERE slug = 'shadows-of-the-net');

changeSet.author: hugmesh
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO federation_modules (slug, display_name, kind, remote_entry_url, exposed_module, game_slug, version, enabled, metadata) VALUES ('games-shadows-of-the-net', 'Shadows of the Net – CHAT', 'wasm-game', '/_remotes/wasm-fragment/shadows-of-the-net/index.html', NULL, 'shadows-of-the-net', '0.1.0', true, '{"sse":true,"hostAuthoritative":true,"engine":"godot","xr":true}'::jsonb) ON CONFLICT (slug) DO NOTHING;

changeSet.author: hugmesh
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO game_access (game_id, scope, scope_value, granted_by, granted_at) SELECT g.id, 'all', NULL, 'system:migration-056', NOW() FROM games g WHERE g.slug = 'shadows-of-the-net' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM game_access ga WHERE ga.game_id = g.id AND ga.scope = 'all' AND ga.scope_value IS NULL );
